input.summary: Insert a data-return, deletion-certification and transition-assistance provision in Section 11
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 11.3 preserves our license and Commerce One's post-termination support, but it lets Commerce One destroy our and our Customers' data with no return obligation, format or timeline. We have added a 30-day return of that data in a machine-readable format, followed by deletion and written certification, plus transition assistance at then-current rates; we can accept a 90-day assistance period if that is easier.

ops.text: 11.4 Transition Assistance and Data Return. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Commerce One shall (a) at Corio's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Commerce One's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Corio's request, return to Corio all data of Corio and its Customers and Software Users in Commerce One's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Corio in writing, except to the extent retention is required by applicable law.
